descriptions.w3d_s20_forward_global_800e5ca4: Appears to forward three arguments and a global object to a helper when the global exists, otherwise return zero.
descriptions.w3d_s20_call_with_swapped_800e7114: Appears to temporarily replace two fields with other fields of the object while calling a helper, then restore them.
descriptions.w3d_s20_call_with_swapped_800e7160: Appears to temporarily replace two fields with other fields of the object while calling a helper, then restore them.
descriptions.w3d_s20_forward_handle_8013dda8: Appears to resolve a stored handle, clearing it when stale and otherwise passing the object and the address at offset 52 to a helper.
descriptions.w3d_s20_reset_named_801bc430: Appears to initialize a named object, clear a two-word field of the result, run a second helper and return zero.
